title: Aethel: Layered Start
description: A 4-layer Multiple Choice scenario showing the flag system: context size and race set flags that the age and start layers consume to decide which lore cards (and at what detail) each leaf carries.

leaf.prompt: You wake at the edge of the Aethel Wood with the day ahead of you and no one to answer to.

layers.name: context
layers.prompt: Choose your context size. Larger contexts carry more lore at higher detail; smaller ones stay lean for the free tier.

options.title: Human
options.plotEssentials: You are human: short-lived, adaptable, and underestimated.

options.title: Elf
options.plotEssentials: You are an elf of the Aethel Wood: long-lived, and you remember things the world has tried to forget.

layers.name: age
layers.prompt: Choose your age. Older characters know more of the deep history.

options.title: The Road
options.prompt: A merchant caravan has offered you passage south, if you can earn your keep.
options.plotEssentials: You are travelling south with a merchant caravan.

options.title: The Ruin
options.prompt: Below you, half-swallowed by the Wood, the broken towers of an Elder ruin breathe cold air up the slope.
options.plotEssentials: You are exploring an Elder ruin at the forest's edge.
